title: Organic Opportunity Map
summary: Compare a domain with its search competitors, validate a bounded set of candidate topics and turn the evidence into a prioritised organic growth plan.
outcome: A cited, prioritised opportunity map with target evidence, competitor evidence, demand and difficulty signals, recommended next actions and explicit uncertainty labels.
boundary: The Skill does not promise rankings, treat sampled keyword absence as proof of a gap, publish content, change a website or expand beyond the approved market and sample sizes.

catalog_tools.purpose: Sample the target and selected competitors' ranked keywords in one market.
Identify search competitors from overlapping organic visibility.
Validate demand, difficulty, intent and SERP-feature signals for shortlisted topics.

inputs: Business objective, audience and any excluded topics
outputs: Prioritised organic opportunity table with confidence labels
Recommended validation, content and technical next actions

cost.model: Inspected per-call and per-result prices for target sampling, competitor discovery, competitor sampling and keyword validation.
cost.notes: Trial-safe mode uses one target, at most two selected competitors and at most ten validated topics; the exact inspected plan must remain at or below the stated maximum.

approvals: Approve the target, market, selected competitors, sample sizes, exact paid inputs and maximum total before the first metered run
Approve any additional competitor, market, keyword batch or repeated provider call
compatibility: One authorized Scrollport connection with apps, discover, inspect, run and wallet
A local file or conversation state for the checkpoint and final map
